scope: Public typed full-group snapshot and file-backed backup export over IPC/actual CLI. Does not expose full-group import/Finish/reapply or GUI.

environment.test_backend: Private temporary stores, MockBackend, in-memory/temporary Unix sockets; no physical HID/production daemon

contract.snapshot: Settings-owner ReadProfileGroup snapshot with typed summary and opaque JSON-string revision token; no client-side revision arithmetic or persisted config mutation.
contract.session: 32 lowercase hex id, bound to device/group/expected; Begin is idempotent before device lookup for existing session. New session rejects stale source. Status/read/cancel/release do not require target still attached.
contract.packing: Unlinked temporary file, owned blocking worker/permit; registry and state mutexes not held during asset staging/hash/copy. Ready file immutable. No receipt/commit/HID/Apply.
contract.cancellation: Cancel requested immediately; preparing -> cancelling retains quota and admission until actual worker exit. Check at archive writer boundary; prior catalog/staging reads are not interrupted immediately. Ready file closes in blocking worker. Release during preparing/cancelling requests cancellation.
contract.cli: profiles group snapshot/export/status/cancel/release screen|fan-and-lighting, explicit --device or existing unambiguous resolver. Session id on stderr; chunks checked for identity/offset/size/EOF/magic. Local sibling tempfile + file sync + persist_noclobber + parent directory sync. Error/Ctrl+C requests cancel/release with bounded cleanup RPC waits. No full archive in JSON/stdout.

regressions.coverage: Two exports held behind private asset catalog lock; cancellation retains packer/reserved budget, third Begin rejected, other Status responsive; close and release only after blocking work exits.

Actual memory RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend; source changed after Begin, same id returns original export, new stale id rejected, wrong target/group/oversize read/outside EOF rejected, repeated offset returns same bytes, clean codec decode preserves manual0, release removes metadata; only known startup/user PWM writes.

Real lconnectctl subprocess/private Unix socket exports Screen with valid indexed H264 >1MiB and gallery-only image plus sparse media slot; clean-store prepare/decode and last frame verified. Existing destination unchanged. Fan+lighting export preserves explicit fan/pump0 and canonical motherboard source from legacy Application replay.

checks.gui: NOT RUN: no frontend changes or native/browser execution in this slice
checks.hardware: NOT RUN: deferred by user; no physical device accessed

remaining: Full-group upload/inspect/Finish/readback/reapply IPC/CLI and export/import GUI
Extended signal/fault/expiry/shutdown matrix and prompt cancellation during catalog/staging
Runtime admission/reconciliation and production DeviceManager detach/sleep/caller cancellation matrix before public import
Windows ZIP metadata validation and profile/assets mapping
Native/physical acceptance and remaining basic parity checklist; extra LCD effects/Style Express last
